Qualifications and Notes 
- Bid based on owner providing capital improvement certificate. 
• Bid based on non union labor 
- Asbestos, lead, mold or other hazardous material removal not included. 
- No associated air monitoring or testing costs included. 
- No building department filing fees included. 
• Owner is responsible for providing utility service to space. 
• Temporary heat not included 
- Alarm systems not included. 
• Audio /Video systems not included. 
- Control and low voltage wiring not included. 
• Window treatments to be provided by others. 
• All extra work and change orders are subject to cost plus 15%. 
- Owner supplied subs are subject fo a coordination fee. Percentage to be determined. 
- This project will be left in clean condition. Detailed hand cleaning by others. 
-Any repairs to existing conditions other than that described in the scope provided not included. 
- Hoisting of all material and removal of debris will be done by use of existing elevator. 
• Close out documents. Including warranties, sign offs and etc., shall be submitted upon final payment. 
- Skim coating of existing walls not included. 
• This proposal is good for 30 days. After such time prices are subject to change. 
- Controlled inspections not included. 
- Mock ups not included in this proposal and will be billed as a reimbursable expense. 
• My items that appear after final punch list has been determined and agreed upon are considered warranty items and will be handled as such. 
- All appliance and fixture pricing is good for 30 days from date 010^3POSat 
- Change Orders not subject to retainage. 
- Items that am not specified are assumed standard. Any upgrade from standard will result in additional charges. 
- Preparation of "As Built' drawings not included. 
- Contractor will not be responsible for touch ups or clean ups after owners move in company. 
• Maintenance of HVAC and mechanical systems not included. 
• Lighting fixtures will be provided by owner. 
- An allowance of $22,000 is considered for the kitchen appliances at apartments 8A, 10B. ION and 116. 
• Closet doors considered to be hollow wood. 
- Work considered to be done in two phases (Phase 1 - 8A. 10B, 118. 11P. 11J: Phase 2 - 2G. 3M, 8H, 10F, 10N) 
Please do not hesitate to call if you have any questions. 
Regards, 
Carlos J. Guzman

reproductive value is=not the right way to formulate the problem. His model (and also those ment=oned above) use the 
numerator of reproductive value, but the normalization=is different. To put this differently, the reproductive value at 
age x nee=s to be weighted by I_x, the probability of surviving to that age. This we=ghting is missing from the 
formulation directly in terms of reproductive v=lue. 
Alan

CALIFORNIA: This transaction is covered by the California Travel Consumer Restitution Fund (TCRF) if the seller of travel was registered 
and participating in the TCRF at the time of sale and the passenger is located in California at the time of payment. Eligible passengers may 
file a claim with TCRF if the passenger is owed a refund of more than $50 for transportation or travel services which the seller of travel 
failed to forward to a proper provider or such money was not refunded to you when required. The maximum amount which may be paid by 
the TCRF to any one passenger is the total amount paid on behalf of the passenger to the seller of travel, not to exceed $15,000. A claim 
must be submitted to the TCRF within 12 months after the scheduled completion date of the travel. A claim must include sufficient 
documentation to prove your claim and a $35 processing fee. Claimants must agree to waive their right to other civil remedies against a 
registered participating seller of travel for matters arising out of a sale for which you file a TCRF claim. You may request a claim form by 
writing to: Travel Consumer Restitution Corporation; P.O. Box 6001; Larkspur, CA 94977-6001; or by visiting TCRC's website at: 
www.tcrcinfo.org.

CALIFORNIA: This transaction is covered by the California Travel Consumer Restitution Fund (TCRF) if the seller of travel was registered 
and participating in the TCRF at the time of sale and the passenger is located in California at the time of payment. Eligible passengers may 
file a claim with TCRF if the passenger is owed a refund of more than $50 for transportation or travel services which the seller of travel 
failed to forward to a proper provider or such money was not refunded to you when required. The maximum amount which may be paid by 
the TCRF to any one passenger is the total amount paid on behalf of the passenger to the seller of travel, not to exceed $15,000. A claim 
must be submitted to the TCRF within 12 months after the scheduled completion date of the travel. A claim must include sufficient 
documentation to prove your claim and a $35 processing fee. Claimants must agree to waive their right to other civil remedies against a 
registered participating seller of travel for matters arising out of a sale for which you file a TCRF claim. You may request a claim form by 
writing to: Travel Consumer Restitution Corporation; P.O. Box 6001; Larkspur, CA 94977-6001; or by visiting TCRC's website at: 
www.tcrcinfo.org.

Qualifications and Notes 
- Bid based on owner providing capital improvement certificate. 
• Bid based on non union labor 
- Asbestos, lead, mold or other hazardous material removal not included. 
- No associated air monitoring or testing costs included. 
- No building department filing fees included. 
• Owner is responsible for providing utility service to space. 
• Temporary heat not included 
- Alarm systems not included. 
• Audio /Video systems not included. 
- Control and low voltage wiring not included. 
• Window treatments to be provided by others. 
• All extra work and change orders are subject to cost plus 15%. 
- Owner supplied subs are subject fo a coordination fee. Percentage to be determined. 
- This project will be left in clean condition. Detailed hand cleaning by others. 
-Any repairs to existing conditions other than that described in the scope provided not included. 
- Hoisting of all material and removal of debris will be done by use of existing elevator. 
• Close out documents. Including warranties, sign offs and etc., shall be submitted upon final payment. 
- Skim coating of existing walls not included. 
• This proposal is good for 30 days. After such time prices are subject to change. 
- Controlled inspections not included. 
- Mock ups not included in this proposal and will be billed as a reimbursable expense. 
• My items that appear after final punch list has been determined and agreed upon are considered warranty items and will be handled as such. 
- All appliance and fixture pricing is good for 30 days from date 010^3POSat 
- Change Orders not subject to retainage. 
- Items that am not specified are assumed standard. Any upgrade from standard will result in additional charges. 
- Preparation of "As Built' drawings not included. 
- Contractor will not be responsible for touch ups or clean ups after owners move in company. 
• Maintenance of HVAC and mechanical systems not included. 
• Lighting fixtures will be provided by owner. 
- An allowance of $22,000 is considered for the kitchen appliances at apartments 8A, 10B. ION and 116. 
• Closet doors considered to be hollow wood. 
- Work considered to be done in two phases (Phase 1 - 8A. 10B, 118. 11P. 11J: Phase 2 - 2G. 3M, 8H, 10F, 10N) 
Please do not hesitate to call if you have any questions. 
Regards, 
Carlos J. Guzman
